## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## User impact

Describe the visible behavior, compatibility, performance, or security impact.

## Verification

List the checks and manual scenarios you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows `AGENTS.md` ownership and performance constraints.
- [ ] Tests cover new or corrected behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes, or the omitted checks and reason are stated above.
- [ ] No secrets, private session data, local paths, or generated build output are included.
